manual.uncertain: Sync acceptance is not confirmed. Check this exact request before trying another sync. A missing result does not prove the request was rejected.
manual.readFailed: Cannot read the current sync result. Previous task details are hidden; check again after access or service recovery.
manual.partialFailure: Some updates were applied, but the full sync failed. After fixing the source problem, explicitly retry to reconcile again.
manual.failed: Sync failed. Existing successful content is retained where possible. Fix the source problem, then explicitly retry.
manual.rejected: The service rejected this sync before accepting it. Check access and binding availability, then explicitly try again.

bindingSetup.title: Add a saved Confluence source
bindingSetup.prerequisite: Requires an active Knowledge Confluence connection already saved for your account and tenant. Assistant OAuth connections are separate. No credential setup is performed here.
bindingSetup.noConnections: No owned active Knowledge connection is available. Ask your administrator to provision one; connecting the Assistant alone does not create it.
bindingSetup.scope: Import scope: this homepage and its descendants, up to 10 levels. Other space pages, images, attachments and comments are excluded. Saving only creates a manual source binding; use Sync now afterward.
bindingSetup.readFailed: This source could not be verified. Check access and the saved connection, then retry the read.
bindingSetup.rejected: No binding was accepted. Refresh sources and verify the connection and space before saving again.
bindingSetup.storageFailed: Recovery information could not be saved safely. No new binding can be submitted from this control.
bindingSetup.saved: Binding confirmed. Refresh Sources if needed, then use its explicit sync control to import the selected pages.
bindingSetup.uncertain: Binding result is unconfirmed. Check this exact request before adding another source; a failed or missing readback does not prove the save failed.

connectionSetup.title: Create a Confluence Cloud connection
connectionSetup.scope: Atlassian Cloud only. Verify your account with a read-only request and save encrypted credentials. This does not bind a space or start synchronization. Existing self-hosted connections are unchanged.
connectionSetup.name: Connection name
connectionSetup.saved: Connection saved. Choose Load saved connections below, then verify a space and save its binding.
connectionSetup.uncertain: The save result is unknown. Do not submit credentials again. Check this request’s saved connection. A missing receipt does not prove the save failed.
connectionSetup.storage: Recovery storage is unavailable or belongs to another request. No further credential submission is allowed.
connectionSetup.readFailed: Saved connection could not be confirmed. Keep this request ID and try readback again.
connectionSetup.rejected: Connection was not saved. Check your fields, current access and Cloud account permissions.
connectionSetup.keyRequired: Connection creation is unavailable. An administrator must configure GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY for the Knowledge API and workers.
connectionSetup.encryptionUnavailable: Credential encryption is unavailable. Ask an administrator to check GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY and encryption support in the Knowledge API and workers.

connectionControls.title: Saved connection controls
connectionControls.scope: Pause applies to every binding using this connection. It blocks new syncs and stops existing runs at their next authorization check. Already-issued work may finish, processing may remain visible briefly, and partial effects remain. This does not revoke the provider token or remove indexed content. Resume never starts a sync.
connectionControls.hidden: {{count}} bindings on this page are hidden because you cannot view them.
connectionControls.confirm: I understand this changes the connection for all affected bindings.
connectionControls.uncertain: The change outcome is unconfirmed. Read current status before making another decision; no retry will be sent.
connectionControls.saved: The connection change was acknowledged. Read current status to continue.
connectionControls.readFailed: Current connection status could not be read. Refresh again; no change was retried.
connectionControls.storage: Recovery state is unavailable or changed in another view. Changes are blocked; use a fresh view to read current status.
connectionControls.unsupported: This saved connection state does not support pause or resume. No change has been made.
connectionControls.credentialsSaved: Replacement credentials verified and saved. Status is unchanged. Review current metadata, then explicitly resume or sync when ready.
connectionControls.credentialsUncertain: Replacement outcome is uncertain. Read current metadata before deciding. A changed revision does not prove this replacement succeeded. Never automatically retry credentials.
connectionControls.credentialsScope: Verify replacement credentials against this saved Cloud hostname and replace them for every binding. Status is preserved; no synchronization starts. Previously admitted work stops at its next authority check; already-admitted I/O may finish.
connectionControls.credentialsUnavailable: Credential replacement needs connection setup readiness, including GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Pause and resume remain available.

status.noTextContent: No text content - please reprocess this document

versionHistory.pageReadFailed: Version history could not be checked. Retry this page or reopen the document; access or saved versions may have changed.
versionHistory.pagingScope: Pages show currently returned version metadata. History can change between reads; comparing or restoring checks access again.
versionHistory.title: Version History
versionHistory.autoSaveHint: Versions are automatically saved when the document is updated
versionHistory.rollbackDesc: This will restore document "{{title}}" to the content of version #{{version}}.
versionHistory.rollbackWarning: Current content will be saved as a new version. This action is reversible.
versionHistory.restorePending: Rebuilding version #{{version}}. The previous content remains available until publication succeeds. Check the document list for the result.
versionHistory.restoreFailureNext: Check the document status, access, and version before retrying manually. If it still fails, contact an administrator with document ID {{documentId}}.
versionHistory.sourceUnavailable: This version has no supported immutable source identity. Its content cannot be verified.

processingDiagnostics.conflictDetail: The document state changed or another operation owns it. Refresh its status before deciding whether to retry.
processingDiagnostics.retryAdvisory: Retry requires editor access. The server checks the current document state again; this suggestion does not guarantee a successful retry.

actions.retry_document: Check the source and processing configuration, then use Full retry in the processing menu.
actions.wait: Processing is still in progress. Wait for an updated status before submitting again.
actions.replace_source: The upload failed. Check the original file and upload a replacement; retrying processing cannot repair a missing source.
actions.inspect_upload: The upload has not completed. Check the upload receipt and document list before uploading again.
actions.inspect_source_sync: A source sync still owns this document. Check the source connection and sync status.
actions.inspect_lifecycle: A document lifecycle transition is pending. Check its status before starting another processing action.
actions.inspect_execution: Publication is pending. Check the processing execution before retrying.
actions.restore_document: This document is archived. Restore it before requesting another processing action.
actions.enable_document: This document is disabled. Enable it before requesting another processing action.
actions.inspect_document: This state does not support a suggested retry. Check the document details or contact an administrator.
